setup.clientGuideSabnzbd:
Correct way to configure Snatcharr with SABnzbd in docker-compose.yml:

services:
  snatcharr:
    volumes:
      - /your-shared-host-folder:/downloads:noexec
  sabnzbd:
    volumes:
      - /your-shared-host-folder:/snatcharr

Add a SABnzbd Category:
  Category: snatcharr
  Priority: Default (recommended Low)
  Processing: +Delete
  Script: None
  Folder/Path: /snatcharr

API Key: SABnzbd → Config → General → API Key

security.heading: Safety Settings
security.authMethodsHelp:
Local
Snatcharr manages accounts locally (username / password).

Jellyfin Auth
Login with Jellyfin user via API. Sync user data.

Seerr Auth
Jellyfin user per API. Sync user data, email address, Plex data.

Organizr v2 Auth
Login with Organizr user per API, then store token.

Organizr as SSO
Check Organizr token or call /api/v2/auth — if valid, auto-login user. Sync user data possible.

JFA-GO Auth
Login via JFA-GO API. Sync user data.
security.authMethodsFallbackNote: If you want to have Local & external Auth make sure to set local auth as fallback and external auth in main.
security.groupLimitsDesc: Daily and concurrent limits for grabs and downloads. Header shows (global) / (you).
security.grabsPerDayDesc: 0 = unlimited. Synced to users without custom limits. Resets at 11:00 AM.
security.manualNzbPerDayDesc: For users with upload grant. 0 = unlimited.
security.downloadsPerDayDesc: Finished file downloads per user. 0 = unlimited.
security.concurrentGrabsDesc: Queued + downloading + paused at once. 0 = unlimited.
security.downloadSpeedLimitDescription: Throttle how fast non-admins download finished files from the Snatcharr server (Mbit/s). Does not limit grabbing/queuing. 0 = unlimited. Admins are not limited.
security.groupFiltersDesc: Applied to search grabs and manual NZB uploads.
security.titleBlacklistDesc: One term per line — matched in release title
security.domainBlacklistDesc: One host per line — manual NZB URLs only
security.extensionLimitsDesc: If the release title contains an extension (e.g. .mp4), total size must fall within min–max MB. Empty max = no upper limit.
